name: Terrorism
overview: Scripture reveals God's desire for peace and justice among nations, as seen in Isaiah's vision where swords are transformed into tools of peace and war ceases. The Lord detests evil and calls His people to depart from it, actively pursuing peace as a reflection of His holiness. Jesus teaches a departure from retaliatory violence, challenging the principle of 'an eye for an eye' and pointing toward a higher standard of love and forgiveness. Ultimately, God hears the humble and prepares their hearts, assuring that His judgment will bring an end to violence and upheaval.
